name: Charles Oliveira
photo_coverage: Good. Front: March 2026 press conference (Las Vegas Sun, reference-only), ESPN studio headshot and a 2021 gym portrait (CC0). Three-quarter: March 2026 presser and a 2021 smiling headshot (CC0). Profile-ish: 2021 training shot (CC0). Physique: two ESPN full-body cutouts showing all tattoos. The CC0 photos are from 2021, before he bleached his hair.

face.shape: Long, narrow and angular, with a high forehead, very prominent cheekbones and hollow cheeks tapering to a narrow chin. Lean, sculpted look with deep lines.
face.jaw: Narrow and well defined, with visible jaw angles; the jaw line runs fairly steeply to the chin.
face.chin: Narrow, slightly pointed, of medium-tall height, projecting slightly.
face.cheekbones: Very prominent and high; strong hollows below them, plus deep nasolabial folds from the nose to the mouth corners.
face.brow_ridge: Fairly prominent; the eyes look slightly deep-set.
face.forehead: High and broad, with horizontal creases; temples slightly hollow.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium, slightly deep-set; strong crow's feet when he smiles; mild bags.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, with a slight angle about two-thirds out; the inner ends dip a little toward the nose.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown, staying dark even with the bleached hair (a strong contrast).

nose.width: Medium, with a fairly narrow bridge.
nose.bridge: Straight and narrow-to-medium from the front.
nose.hump: None to very slight; straight in the 2021 training shot.
nose.tip: Defined, slightly rounded, pointing slightly down; projects well.

face.mouth_lips: Wide mouth with a thin upper lip and medium lower lip. Resting expression closed, often a tight-lipped half smile; when he smiles he shows a very wide, bright-white even set of teeth.

ears.cauliflower_ear: No clear cauliflower ear; at most mild thickening in the upper folds (studio headshot). Model normal ears.

face.notable_marks_scars: Deep nasolabial folds and forehead creases; no large scars visible.

hair.style: Since about 2024: short bleached platinum crop, about 3 cm on top worn textured/spiky and pushed forward, about 1 cm at the sides. In 2021 it was the same short cut in his natural dark colour, with a slight wave.
hair.colour: Bleached platinum: pale, slightly yellowish off-white (ESPN cutout and March 2026). Natural colour (2021) is very dark brown to black; brows and stubble remain dark.
hair.hairline: Slightly receded at the temples with a gently rounded front; hair density on top is moderate (scalp shows through the short bleached hair under studio light).
hair.texture: Short and slightly coarse, with a light natural wave.

facial_hair.length_mm: About 1-2 mm; clean-shaven or nearly so in the 2026 and studio photos.
facial_hair.shape: Light shadow on the upper lip and chin only; cheeks clear.

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on well-lit skin (box in source pixels). Studio (ESPN/UFC) cutouts are high-key and warm-graded, so they read lighter and pinker than arena or daylight photos; the average mixes lighting on purpose.
skin.undertone: Warm golden-olive; deeply tanned, with golden-orange highlights under stage light.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles visible; deep expression lines; sparse body hair on the legs.

body.build: Long-limbed and lean for a lightweight (178 cm) with a very long reach (188 cm, 10 cm more than his height). Athletic and wiry rather than bulky.
body.body_fat_notes: Low body fat: clear abs and obliques in the studio cutouts.
body.shoulders: Fairly broad and square for his frame.
body.arms: Long, lean and sinewy, with defined forearms.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with slim thighs and slim calves.
body.posture: Upright, slightly forward lean, shoulders relaxed; orthodox stance.
body.notable_physique_traits: Long arms, narrow waist, heavily tattooed torso, both arms and both lower legs; bleached hair against tanned skin.

tattoos.description: Cursive script 'Jamais desista' (Portuguese for 'never give up'), running down the side of the neck.
Black-and-grey realistic portraits: a portrait at his right shoulder/pec edge, an older bearded man on the right pec, and a laughing little girl on the left pec with the name 'Tayla' in script below.
tattoos.size: About 40 cm wide x 20 cm tall

tattoos.description: Black-and-grey portrait of a smiling baby with a name in script below (ESPN stance-left cutout).
Dense black-and-grey sleeve of figures and faces, including an ape/gorilla face on the forearm.
Black-and-grey sleeve: a horse head on the shoulder/upper arm and horse-and-rider figures down the forearm.

tattoos.where: Right lower leg (shin and calf, knee to ankle)
tattoos.description: Large black-and-grey cartoon piece: a boy in a cap with arms crossed above a small turtle-like cartoon creature near the ankle, with smoke/cloud shading and more figures above the knee.
Black-and-grey figure (a lion or a warrior, not clear).

accessories_seen: Thick gold chain (2021), black BetCombat cap (2021-2023), glasses off-duty (2023), a purple suit at the March 2026 press conference.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC-issued shorts (Venum era): a multicolour brushstroke pattern of red, blue, orange and yellow on black, a black side panel with 'OLIVEIRA' lettering (yellow or white) on his left leg, black waistband with a red UFC tab, crypto.com logo. In 2021 training photos: black-and-red BetCombat shorts and white BetCombat shirt.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets; ears look average, so no change is suggested.

notes: Confidence: high for hair (current bleached look), skin, tattoos and build; medium-high for face proportions; medium for morph values. 8 photos: 3 Commons CC0 (2021, natural dark hair), 5 reference-only (ESPN x3, Las Vegas Sun March 2026 x2). What to watch: (1) Current look is bleached platinum short hair (#dcdabd) with DARK brows and stubble; use colour_hex_natural only for a pre-2024 look. (2) The face is long and gaunt: very prominent cheekbones, hollow cheeks, deep nasolabial folds, narrow pointed chin, long straight nose; default MakeHuman cheeks are far too full. (3) Wide mouth and bright white teeth when smiling. (4) Tattoos: portraits across the chest ('Tayla' under the girl on the left pec), 'Jamais desista' on the left neck, two full sleeves (horse on the left), cartoon piece on the right shin; mirror-check, since l/r are HIS sides. (5) Body: long arms (reach 188 cm), slim legs, narrow waist; scale to 177.8 cm. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65 like src/avatar3d.js; l-/r- values are symmetric.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/charles-oliveira.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn-stance-left.png, espn-stance-right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Tall Muay Thai-style high guard, upright, walks forward behind a long jab and right hand.
